runtimeArgs: const h=require('http'),f=require('fs'),p=require('path');const root=p.resolve('games');const t={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.png':'image/png','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.txt':'text/plain; charset=utf-8'};h.createServer((q,s)=>{let u=decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]);if(u.endsWith('/'))u+='index.html';const fp=p.join(root,u);if(!fp.startsWith(root)){s.writeHead(403);return s.end();}f.readFile(fp,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404);return s.end('not found');}s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':t[p.extname(fp)]||'application/octet-stream','Cache-Control':'no-store'});s.end(d);});}).listen(8780,'127.0.0.1')
